components.name: Session Dot
components.description: The 8 pt status dot in its four states. Red and unacknowledged pulses; done-and-waiting breathes; Reduce Motion swaps the pulse for a ring. System colours stand in as their dark-appearance hex.
components.css: .ds-notch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 18px 0 12px; height: 32px; background: #000; border-radius: 0 0 14px 14px; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; position: relative; } .ds-dot-idle { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.32); } .ds-dot-working { background: #ffd60a; } .ds-dot-done { background: #30d159; } .ds-dot-needs-you { background: #ff453b; animation: ds-pulse 0.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .ds-dot-breathe { animation: ds-breathe 2.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } @keyframes ds-pulse { from { transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(255,69,59,0.35); } to { transform: scale(1.4); box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(255,69,59,0.9); } } @keyframes ds-breathe { from { opacity: 1; } to { opacity: 0.45; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dot-needs-you, .ds-dot-breathe { animation: none; box-shadow: none; opacity: 1; } .ds-dot-needs-you::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -3px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9); } }

narrative.overview:
Lightswitch draws nothing of its own except a black shape that extends the MacBook's notch and the coloured dots inside it. The world is the platform's: the system font at 10 to 13 pt, the system's semantic status colours, standard grouped Settings controls, a text-only menu bar menu. Personality lives in the dots and in motion that only ever means a change of state.

Density is high and fixed. The closed notch is a row of 8 pt dots at 10 pt spacing; the open panel is a 400 pt list of 32 pt rows. Nothing decorative is drawn behind the physical notch, which has no pixels: layouts leave a clear gap exactly the notch's measured width.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black shape, white text at opacity steps, three system state colours.
One typeface (system), sizes 10 to 13 pt, monospaced digits wherever numbers tick.
Motion is state: springs for open/close, a pulse for "needs you", a slow breathe for "done and waiting", nothing at rest.
Shadows appear only in response to state; at rest every shadow is opacity 0.
Reduce Motion swaps the pulse for a white ring; every dot and row carries a spoken label.

rules.name: The Dim White Rule
rules.body: On the notch, every non-state colour is white at an opacity step (9, 14, 32, 40, 45, 55, 60, 85, 90, 100 %). No grey hex ever appears on black.

rules.name: The Words Beside Colour Rule
rules.body: A state colour never stands alone. In the open list and the peek the state is also a word; in the closed notch the dot's accessibility label speaks it; red adds motion (or the ring).

rules.name: The Counting Digits Rule
rules.body: Anything that counts or ticks (the summary, the age, "+N", the lux readout) uses monospaced digits so it does not jitter.

rules.name: The Shadow-On-State Rule
rules.body: No surface carries a shadow at rest. The panel's shadow arrives with open or hover; the dot's arrives with the pulse; both return to 0.

dos: Do fill every notch shape with pure black and put nothing on it except white at an opacity step or a system state colour.
Do keep type in the system font between 10 and 13 pt and use monospaced digits for anything that counts.
Do pair every state colour with its word (row label, peek detail) or its spoken label.
Do animate only state changes: springs for open/close, smooth 0.3 for the peek, the pulse for unacknowledged red, the breathe for done-and-waiting, easeOut 0.12 for row hover.
Do honour Reduce Motion: no pulse, no breathe, the white ring instead.
Do keep the four dot slots fixed and overflow into "+N".
Do use standard grouped Form controls in Settings; draw custom only the ratio bar and the 8 pt status dot.
donts: Don't draw behind the physical notch; leave the measured gap clear in the closed, peek and open layouts.
Don't introduce a custom typeface, glyph icons or bitmap images: the menu bar icon and app icon are drawn dots and the notch silhouette.
Don't give a surface a shadow at rest; the panel lift and dot glow are opacity 0 until open, hover or pulse.
Don't use grey for idle or for secondary text on black; use white at the recorded opacity.
Don't tint chrome with a state colour; red, yellow and green appear on dots, state words and the peek detail only (and, in Settings, systemRed for errors and systemOrange for the covered sensor).
